fusions.name: Hamstring Cut
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: Swings in a cone 3.5 tiles long, which deals 28 damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Rafter Drop
fusions.desc: You drop on a line and land 3 tiles from where you stood, and your slashing damage rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Chopping Block
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
